description: Biblioteca central e reutilizável de referências de motion design para o pitch e materiais audiovisuais do VEREDA.

references.title: Ravie's 5-year Showreel (Design + Animation)
references.creator: Ravie & Co.
references.evidenceInspected: Vídeo completo de 47s baixado em resolução 640x360, decomposto em 47 frames individuais com ffmpeg, contact sheet gerado e analisado. Momentos identificados: 0:10-0:12 (lettering 'new hue' e dot matrix), 0:13-0:15 (card UI 'Briefs *' com cursor clicando e abrindo documento), 0:19-0:21 (cidade 3D isométrica monocromática terracota/laranja com avenida e prédios geométricos), 0:34 (cidade vetorial flat 'Every city has a heartbeat').
visualTechniques: Floating minimalist UI card with hover highlight and crisp document unfold
Kinetic editorial typography paired with monospaced data accents
Halftone dot matrix and technical crosshair alignment marks
technicalTechniques: Dynamic micro-interactions driven by minimalist cursor
references.proposedUseInVereda: Cena da cidade/território urbano periciado (Recife e bairros mapeados), cenas de destaque de features do app (Vistoria, Laudo, Matrícula) e letterings de impacto com grid pontilhado de prancheta técnica.

references.title: "Comma" motion graphics
references.creator: seven (@seven_playstudy)
references.evidenceInspected: Vídeo de 25s baixado e decomposto em 25 frames individuais com ffmpeg. Análise de montagem 5x5: ciclo de pontuação, xícara de café estilizada, teclas mecânicas de teclado afundando sob digitação, ritmo calmo com pausas deliberadas.
visualTechniques: Monochromatic black & white & neutral gray palette
Generous negative space and editorial breathing room
Mechanical tactile animations (key presses, stamps, geometric unfolds)
technicalTechniques: Controlled physical damping without exaggerated elastic bounce
Restrained temporal pacing (calm cadence between rapid micro-interactions)
references.proposedUseInVereda: Base de sobriedade jurídica e pericial: ritmo pausado, transições mecânicas para dados cadastrais e selos oficiais, evitando excessos de animação comercial espalhafatosa (anti-AI-slop).

references.title: Code-based UI motion design showreel (One-Shape UI Morph)
references.creator: zero (@twoclipping)
references.type: Code-based UI Motion / Single Shape Morphing
references.evidenceInspected: Transcrição integral pública da especificação XML no JasonZhu.AI, prompt original de 2.711 caracteres, metadados do vídeo MP4 (720x720, 14s, 1.2M visualizações), regras de build e gotchas inspecionados diretamente.
visualTechniques: One shape, never cut: a single container continuously morphs width, height, border-radius, background and position across states
Content swaps with timed opacity/blur so outgoing and incoming text never collide
Cursor-driven storytelling with direct manipulation (clicks, drags, scrubs)
Zero template looks: no particle bursts, no glows, no chromatic gradients, pure functional clarity
technicalTechniques: window.seek(t) pure function of time rendering contract
Closed-form step response spring physics: f(t) = 1 - exp(-zeta * w0 * t) * (cos(wd * t) + (zeta * w0 / wd) * sin(wd * t))
Multi-target additive tracking: track(t, keys) sums independent springs per state transition
Differential dual-edge springs for stretching tabs and toggles
Direct manipulation tracking during cursor hold, spring recovery on release
Strict prohibition of will-change on scaled elements to avoid font blur
Playwright headless browser subframe capture (4x) blended with ffmpeg tmix for motion blur at 60fps
references.proposedUseInVereda: Demonstração central do produto VEREDA: o container de busca se transforma sem cortes em card de imóvel, que se expande para confronto de área (110 m² vs 92 m²), se desdobra em certidão do IPTU/DSQFL, se projeta no lote periciado, abre o mapa de 150m e culmina no Dossiê Definitivo.

references.title: Motion Design Studio Workflow with Claude Opus 5.5
references.creator: Movez (@0xMovez)
references.type: Studio Architecture / Deterministic Pipeline / Review Loop
references.evidenceInspected: Artigo completo de 12 etapas inspecionado via Thread Navigator, scripts de renderização Playwright/ffmpeg, analisador de áudio librosa/numpy, sintetizador de SFX wav em Node, especificação de regras de estúdio e loop de crítica automatizado com contact sheets.
visualTechniques: Editorial and architectural graphic design hierarchy
Multi-reference hybrid language (combining UI morph with kinetic type and real assets)
Every 2 to 4 seconds a new visual payoff appears
Contact sheet review loop (scoring 1-10 on hook, readability, motion, variety, brand accuracy)
technicalTechniques: Headless browser pipes PNG stream directly into ffmpeg stdin (-f image2pipe -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -pix_fmt yuv420p)
Deterministic PRNG with mulberry32 seeded noise (zero Math.random)
Beat grid detection (librosa onset peaks and downbeats written to beats.json)
Procedural sound synthesis (click, pop, thump, whoosh) triggered on beat peaks
Multi-session production protocol with formal review_log.md and documented gates
references.proposedUseInVereda: Infraestrutura de renderização do projeto: pipeline headless determinístico, loop de revisão visual com contact sheets automatizados, biblioteca matemática de molas puras e registro formal de QA em docs/review-log.md.
